hero.title: Learn to Build AI Agents

certificate.title: Verified Certificate
certificate.description: Earn a verifiable e-certificate upon completion. Share on LinkedIn and add to your resume.

global.title: Available Worldwide
global.description: Learn in your native language. 25+ languages supported with culturally adapted content.

projects.title: Real-World Projects
projects.description: Build actual AI agents — from customer support bots to multi-agent systems.

community.title: Global Community
community.description: Connect with learners worldwide. Discussion forums, study groups, and peer reviews.

module1.title: Introduction to AI Agents
module1.description: Understand what AI agents are, their types, components, and real-world applications.

module2.title: AI & Machine Learning Fundamentals
module2.description: Core AI concepts, ML paradigms, LLMs, embeddings, and the agent ecosystem.

module3.title: Designing & Architecting Agents
module3.description: Architecture patterns, goal definition, memory systems, and reasoning flows.

module4.title: Implementing AI Agents
module4.description: Hands-on building with Python, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Claude (Anthropic), and MCP tool integration.

module5.title: Advanced Concepts
module5.description: Multi-agent systems, safety, ethics, deployment, and production scaling.

module6.title: Project-Based Learning
module6.description: Build real AI agents and complete a capstone project for certification.

pricing.title: Accessible to Everyone
pricing.description: Pricing adjusted to your region's purchasing power. Scholarships available.
